description: Delete one scheduled change monitor owned by the calling IP (its event history is removed too). When to use: the user no longer needs to watch a page, or the per-IP monitor limit was reached. Do not use: to pause a monitor temporarily - there is no pause; delete and re-create. Returns: {ok, deleted, monitor_id, note}; unknown or foreign ids return {ok:false,error:'monitor_not_found'} and delete nothing. Free (not metered); rate-limited to 20 calls/min per IP.
name: web_monitor_delete
title: Web Monitor Delete
